about: The names that a description of an API may use, for programs that write descriptions. docs/reference/rules.md explains each key. Concord's tests write this file from the macro's own tables and check every example against the macro.
readers: A reader that meets a key it does not know must stop, not skip it: the key is a rule that the reader cannot apply. Later releases may add keys; a change in the meaning of a key changes schema.

client_input.what: a required input of the client
client_input.probe: client Probe(NAME: String) { base "https://a.test"; query { NAME; } GET probe(); }

client_option.what: an optional input of the client
client_option.probe: client Probe(NAME?: String) { base "https://a.test"; query { NAME; } GET probe(); }

scope_in_client.what: a scope that is a child of the client
scope_in_client.probe: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope NAME { GET probe(); } }

scope_in_scope.what: a scope that is a child of a scope
scope_in_scope.probe: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope outer { scope NAME { GET probe(); } } }

scope_input.what: a required input of a scope
scope_input.probe: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope outer(NAME: String) { query { NAME; } GET probe(); } }

scope_option.what: an optional input of a scope
scope_option.probe: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope outer(NAME?: String) { query { NAME; } GET probe(); } }

endpoint_in_client.what: an endpoint that is a child of the client

endpoint_in_scope.what: an endpoint that is a child of a scope
endpoint_in_scope.probe: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope outer { GET NAME(); } }

endpoint_input.what: a required input of an endpoint
endpoint_input.probe: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope outer { GET probe(NAME: String) { query { NAME; } } } }

endpoint_option.what: an optional input of an endpoint
endpoint_option.probe: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope outer { GET probe(NAME?: String) { query { NAME; } } } }

part.probe: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; part NAME(shared?: String) { query { shared; } } GET probe(..NAME); }

type.rule: split the name at each _, put the first character of each part in upper case, and join the parts; a digit never splits a part

module.rule: the client's name in lower case, with a _ before each capital that follows a lower-case letter or a digit, and before the last capital of a run that a lower-case letter follows

reserved.what: the Rust keywords, raw (`r#type`) or not; `Self` is here for the client's module name
the name by which the client's inputs are written (`client.key`)
the names of the scopes above the name, and for an input of a scope, that scope's own name
the methods of a client: a child of the client or an optional input of the client would add one
the methods of a scope's handle: a child of a scope or an optional input of a scope would add one
the methods of a call: an optional input of an endpoint would add one
the prefix of the settings that Concord may add to a client, a handle or a call
the items at the root of a client's module: a child of the client whose type is one of them
the names of the children of the node that an optional input belongs to: its setter and the child's method would collide

collisions.what: two children of one node may not have the same type (the `type` conversion)
accept: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope one2 { GET probe(); } scope one_3 { GET probe(); } }
refuse: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; scope one2 { GET probe(); } scope one_2 { GET probe(); } }

collisions.what: two children of one node, or two parts, may not have the same name
accept: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; GET probe(); scope inner { GET probe(); } }
refuse: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; GET probe(); POST probe(); }

collisions.what: two inputs of one node, its parts' inputs included, may not have the same name
accept: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; part p(a?: String) { query { a; } } GET probe(b: String, ..p) { query { b; } } }
refuse: client Probe { base "https://a.test"; part p(a?: String) { query { a; } } GET probe(a: String, ..p) { query { a; } } }
